message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, each coin can land either heads (H) or tails (T).  
The total number of heads you can obtain ranges from **0** (all tails) up to **3** (all heads).  

So the possible outcomes for the number of heads are:

- 0 heads  
- 1 head  
- 2 heads  
- 3 heads  

These are the only possibilities when tossing three coins.
